hypothesis: A station-mapped, calibrated ensemble forecast may have positive fee- and depth-adjusted entry-to-settlement expectancy only after prospectively recorded forecast, quote, and official settlement evidence is sufficient.

excluded: range contracts until exact tie semantics are independently verified

feature_schema.target_date: ISO local date at settlement station
feature_schema.ensemble_members: actual returned decimal member values by model
feature_schema.book_timestamp: UTC ISO timestamp required before any paper candidate

primary_metric: one-sided 95% cluster-bootstrap lower confidence bound of fee- and depth-adjusted net dollars per contract, entry-to-settlement only
